'''Zov''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. Following the [[Battle of Corellia]], Zov was among the Republic forces that remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to secure the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] refinery region, and was stationed at [[Sentinel Outpost]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Zov appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Classic Gear Vendor for the Republic faction in the Black Hole Daily Area, which was added in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]].<ref name="TOR" />
